waivers.reason: U7 is the ESP32-WROVER-E module, which carries its own 3V3 decoupling on its module PCB. C30 (22 uF) and C31 (100 nF) are bulk/backup at the module pin, and the loop the check measures includes the module's GND pad distance. Espressif's module reference design needs only a 10-22 uF + 0.1 uF pair near pin 2, with no loop limit.
